target_customer: US importers, customs brokers and developers or AI agents that file customs entries with CBP
problem: Legacy ABI customs software was built for people keying entries into screens, and duty overpayment is common. Tarifflo exposes classification, entry creation and filing as API calls and finds refunds on past entries.
business_model: Usage-based API and software, one key one meter one bill, plus refund recovery audits
product_category: Customs compliance and trade automation API

founders.name: Bryce Judy
founders.background_notes: Licensed CBP customs broker and data scientist per YC page. Met co-founder via Utah State Sandbox program.

founders.name: Tanner Helms
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in press about the 2025 Utah Entrepreneur Challenge; one outlet calls him founder and CEO.

competitors.name: Zonos
competitors.what: HS code classification and landed cost API

competitors.name: GingerControl
competitors.what: HTS classification and duty API covering Chapter 99 layers

competitors.name: TariffLens
competitors.what: AI HTS classification platform with API

technical_complexity.rationale: Classification with LLMs plus direct CBP ABI transmission needs domain data and CBP approval, but each part uses known techniques.

defensibility.rationale: Broker licensing knowledge and CBP client rep approval for live filing add friction, but several funded rivals sell similar classification.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to say as of 2026-11. Flexport reportedly uses AI in brokerage (vendor blog claim).

market_need_then: The 2025 and 2026 tariff changes, Chapter 99 duties and IEEPA refunds created heavy demand for classification and refund recovery. Press in March 2025 framed Tarifflo as helping firms navigate a trade war landscape.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short, confident, technical; headline 'The rails under modern customs'

branding.community_and_virality: Won $20K grand prize at the 2025 Tim Draper Utah Entrepreneur Challenge. Press misspells the name as Tarriflo in places.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand press beyond competition coverage; the name is easy to misspell, as seen in third-party sources.

outcome_analysis: Tarifflo started as a Utah State student startup, won a $20K prize in March 2025 and joined YC in Summer 2026. A licensed customs broker as CEO and the tariff turbulence of 2025 and 2026 are tailwinds. It faces funded classification rivals. Outcome is still open as of November 2026.
notes: Funding: aggregators (yespress, vcbacked) report a $500K pre-seed on a $10M cap closed 2025-01, and one gives a conflicting Sept 2026 date. Unverified, not recorded as a round. Outcome searches found no news on the company. Competitor sources are vendor comparison pages from 2026 near the S26 batch. HQ listed Salt Lake City by YC but Provo or Logan in older press. Update: the Yespress pre-seed (500K plus, 2025-01, 10M cap) is now recorded and rests on a single outlet; VCBacked gives a conflicting 2026-09 date and Caplight lists 520K total. No investors named.
